Method of Attack: Mirai-based botnet exploiting critical vulnerabilities in Realtek SDK and Arcadyan firmware
Remote code execution via management web interface vulnerability
Command injection vulnerabilities used to propagate malware
Impacted Systems: Realtek-based devices including 200 models from at least 65 vendors (Asus, Belkin, D-Link, Netgear, Tenda, ZTE, Zyxel)
Internet-exposed wireless devices such as residential gateways, travel routers, Wi-Fi repeaters, IP cameras, smart lighting gateways, connected toys
Edimax N150 and N300 Wi-Fi routers
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of management web interface vulnerabilities
Scanning and hacking unpatched devices exposed to the internet
